title: Name of the food
requirement: The proper/common name of the food on the principal display panel.

title: MRP (incl. of all taxes)
requirement: Retail sale price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency, on the package.

title: Net quantity declared
requirement: Net quantity in standard units of weight/measure on the principal display panel.

title: Manufacturer / packer details
requirement: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer or importer (with license no. where applicable).

title: Date marking (mfg / best-before / use-by)
requirement: Month & year of manufacture or pack, or a 'best before'/'use by' date, per the commodity class.
reference: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 – r.6(1)(j), r.2(m)

title: Consumer care contact
requirement: Customer care / complaint contact details on the label.

title: FSSAI licence number
requirement: FSSAI licence/registration number (14-digit) displayed on packaged food.

title: Ingredient list
requirement: Complete list of ingredients in descending order of weight.

title: Veg / non-veg mark
requirement: Green/brown square dot mark indicating vegetarian or non-vegetarian.

title: Expiry date not yet passed
requirement: If an expiry/best-before date is present it should not already be past on the day of inspection.
